scope: Five application source optimizations; no compiler/runtime change, default rollout or legacy RC retirement.

items.title: Scalar VM frames and scoped bytecode queries
items.result: Per-instruction frame/code copies removed; frame error writeback fixed.

items.title: Borrowed tree AST with separate mutable state
items.result: Expression, statement and function body traversal no longer clones the immutable program.

items.title: Scoped object field queries
items.result: Scalar queries do not copy unselected managed payloads; owned snapshot accessors and unsupported mutation paths remain.

items.title: Borrowed EDA traversal and fresh parser child transfer
items.result: Read visitors avoid copied subtrees; public independent-copy APIs retain their semantics.

items.title: Indexed overlap scanning and stable index sorting
items.result: No copied suffix per candidate; auxiliary ordering stores integer indices. Dense comparisons remain quadratic.

items.title: Fresh child transfer retains spare capacity
items.result: Depth-24 probe: cumulative traffic 45,472 to 15,136 bytes; managed peak 5,536 to 10,880 bytes. No capacity tuning in this batch.

items.title: VM source costs in RC control
items.result: Rewritten VM source / original RC source geometric mean 1.15557688 over 13 cases; eight case medians are over 5% slower. Tree is 0.83333281 and EDA 0.99969452. This compares sources, not an isolated memory-mode effect. The exact VM hot-spot cause is unprofiled; further tuning is deferred.

performance: COMPARISON.md and results.json retain the full 60-case denominator, measured differences and cutoff cases. Remaining tuning is deferred to user review.
publication: No push, local-main advancement or bootstrap merge in this batch.

measurement_recovery.status: Byte-identical expected inputs recovered; runtime protocol completed with original wall samples.
measurement_recovery.rss_block_repeated: VM trees only; incomplete initial journal preserved
